text:
Maya: Quick follow-up to the authz postmortem (https://redwood.internal/postmortem/2923456789). This thread is for tracking remediation owners/timelines. Please reply with ack + owner + ETA.

Owen: Ack. I'll take hardening of the token validation middleware across services (ensure middleware present and rejects unsigned tokens). ETA: next Tue COB. Will open a PR with tests.

Priya: I'll pick up audit log integrity and retention gaps. Plan: add HMAC signing of ingestion batches + extend retention for critical streams. ETA: 10 business days.

Jorge: Secrets rotation work - I'll draft a phased rollout (staging -> canary -> prod) and the k8s/vault migration script. Need ops window. Propose Sat 04:00 UTC.

sec-bot: Created ticket INC-3819 and linked to JIRA: https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/INC-3819 (remediation tracking). Please add comments to the ticket once you start work.

Maya: Noticing a recurring cadence: similar authz/token incidents every ~21 days. We should add a long-lived regression test and an alert that surfaces token-validation failures before user impact.

Owen: I'll add an E2E regression test in the CI pipeline that asserts token validation for a sample request across services. Also propose a canary traffic job.

Priya: Prometheus rule suggestion:
```
# alert when >0.2% of requests fail token validation in 5m
- alert: TokenValidationAnomaly
  expr: sum(rate(token_validation_failed_total[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) > 0.002
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Token validation failure rate high"
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/token-validation
```
I'll open a PR for the rule + dashboards.

Jorge: Ops - @ops-team can you confirm the deploy window for Sat 04:00 UTC? Need 2h for scripted rotations.

sec-bot: Ops availability: Sat 2026-04-11 04:00 UTC slot reserved by Jorge. Confirm 24h prior.

Maya: Great. Ownership recap + next steps:
- Owen: middleware audit + PR (ETA Tue COB)
- Priya: audit log HMAC + retention rule + prometheus alert (ETA 10 business days)
- Jorge: secrets rotation script + rollout plan (slot Sat 04:00 UTC)
- Maya: will add regression test to CI and create the canary job.

Maya: I'll run a weekly remediation standup summary and mark INC-3819 progress. Ping me with blockers. :memo:
